card.name: Old-style formal prose, mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Small connecting words (of, than, it, were, not) and verbs inside long, formal, older-style sentences from historical or scientific prose. It fires mostly where a comparison or a degree word such as least, less or free of has just been used.

modes.label: Degree or comparison phrases
modes.description: Words like of, than or least inside phrases of comparison or amount, just before the thing compared.
modes.example: Hence the viscera can glide freely against the wall of the cavity or upon one another with the least possible amount<< of>> friction

modes.label: Linking words in historical narrative
modes.description: Pronouns, verbs or negation inside long clauses in old-fashioned history writing.
modes.example: In order, however, to write intelligibly the story of the first men who here opened their permanent homes,<< it>> will be necessary to go back of them

modes.label: Verbs of effect or harm
modes.description: Verbs such as incurred or inflicting that come before a noun such as injury or ill-will.
